summary:
Turn 99 observed the environment fact that two recorded caveats depended on, turning an inference into a measurement.

The observation. The harness asks the environment for two sockets — a loopback bind and an all-interfaces bind — and the local run reports "socket: operation not permitted" for both. Socket creation is denied outright here, which is exactly why the startup finding's fixed-address probe fails (its dial cannot create a socket) and why the attempt to measure the replica loop's startup phase could not proceed (the listen fails, and with a non-verbose logger the failure is silent, so the loop dies later on a nil listener).

Why this mattered enough to record. Both of those statements had been written as environment-class caveats inferred from a nil listener and from a panic; now they rest on the environment's own error. It also frames the limits precisely for a successor: any check that needs a listener or a dial in this execution environment must treat socket denial as the environment class rather than as target behaviour, and the startup finding's witness is an instance of the applicability its review already recorded (an environment without a route, indeed without sockets, to the probe address).

State at the close. Audit spec version 21. Twelve claim families stand with executed artifacts — nine confirmed violations or consequences (C1 and C3 on a driven history, C2, C4 on a constructed history, C6, C7, C9, C10 with its receiver-side consequences, C11, C12) and two bounded no-violation protections (C5 with its end-to-end reply executed but unreviewed, C8 with its recovery-start follow-up) — the map is current at version 20, every analysis-root file has been read, and the residue is explicit: two capacity-limited items (a review for the client-reply artifact, unit-plus-review capacity for the reader observation), deployment premises that decide whether three findings are live, two paused candidates with resume conditions, and the attribution issue on the superseded C1 artifact. Nothing was weakened, no history invented, and the inference boundaries are recorded as such.
